metadata.description: Plugins for the MTG Assistant Gateway: the end-user plugin (connector plus MTG skill) and the operator plugin (guided deploy and invites). The end-user plugin from this repository reads its gateway address from MTG_GATEWAY_URL; a running gateway serves a filled-in copy at https://<gateway>/plugin/marketplace.json.

plugins.name: mtg-gateway
plugins.description: Magic: The Gathering research, goldfish simulation and safe Archidekt deck edits through an MTG Assistant Gateway. Connector URL comes from MTG_GATEWAY_URL; run /mtg-gateway:setup after installing.

plugins.name: mtg-gateway-operator
plugins.description: For whoever runs the gateway: /mtg-gateway-operator:deploy walks through the Swarm, Authentik, Portainer and proxy setup with secrets created as Docker secrets; /mtg-gateway-operator:invite adds a user.
